subject: shinyBS alert cannot be wrapped in renderUI?

messages.author: 80ac11e65419558c
messages.subject: shinyBS alert cannot be wrapped in renderUI?
parts:
Hi all,

I have a problem wrapping an alert from the package shinyBS within renderUI. No error is thrown but the alert does not display at all. Is there something wrong with the way I'm doing it, or must the alert be standalone and not wrapped within renderUI? Thanks!


ui.R

library(shiny)
library(shinyBS)

shinyUI(basicPage(
  radioButtons(inputId = "show_alert", "Show alert?", 
               choices = c("Show alert" = TRUE,
                           "Do not show alert" = FALSE)),
  uiOutput("alert")
))

server.R

library(shiny)
library(shinyBS)

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  
  createAlert(session, inputId = "alert_anchor",
              title = "TITLE GOES HERE",
              message = "MESSAGE GOES HERE",
              type = "info",
              dismiss = TRUE,
              block = FALSE,
              append = TRUE
  )
  
  output$errorAlert <- renderUI({
    if (input$show_alert) {
      bsAlert(inputId = "alert_anchor")
    } else {
      return(NULL)
    }
  })
  
})

Hi all,

Ah thanks ZJ for catching that, silly error on my part. I've fixed that bug (updated code below) but the alert still does not show up and there are no error messages.

What I've tried to debug this:
1. When I replace bsAlert(inputId = "alert_anchor") in server.R with a block of text like p("error"), the text shows up when Show alert = TRUE, so the dynamic UI does work as expected.
2. When I insert bsAlert(inputId = "alert_anchor") in ui.R instead of wrapping it in renderUI and using uiOutput, the alert does show up, but independently of the option that is selected in Show alert?, as expected.

So the only conjecture I have so far is that bsAlert does not work within renderUI, but any insights would be appreciated!
